title: —Which of the two, Stephen asked, would have banished me from his commonwealth?
html_source: Stephen is an aspiring poet. In Plato’s Republic Socrates argues that poets should be banned from his ideal state because they portray falsehoods and appeal to base emotion. (See: Book X.)
